response: Your point about closeups breaking tracking continuity is spot-on—that's a real headache in real-world sports footage. But this hints at a deeper architectural issue: your model likely treats temporal coherence as a learned assumption, not a hard constraint. Have you experimented with persistence mechanisms or graph-based tracking that penalizes ID switches across camera transitions, rather than retraining on 'clean' data? The fact you're solving this iteratively puts you ahead of most sports AI work that just pretends broadcast footage cooperates.
